Work only in /home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/factoring-research. Read AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/SPECIFICATION.md, RESEARCH_LOOP.md, RESEARCH_TEAM.md and research/STATE.md. Do not edit shared solver, Lean, STATE, registries, parent hypotheses or prior evidence.

Own research/findings/H019-root-certificate-screen.md and adjacent H019-certificate-* only. Implement and run the ONE bounded mathematical diagnostic in research/hypotheses/H019.md, which is the controlling complete preregistration. Read it in FULL before any candidate execution. Also read H017-resultant-tail-supply.md and H017-independent-review.md in full; the latter ACCEPTS the theorem and exact certificate. No full factorer or all-input geometry claim exists. H016 processing and H018's corrected degree model are separate.

The fixed protocol specifies four N-only odd inputs (public Random1919; bit sizes4096,16384,65536,262144 with d15,22,34,52), exact H=2^ceil(67473*n/(20000*d²)), h*=ceilH^(4/5), modular squarefree sufficient certificate at verified prime65537, and coefficient d-2 Rouche dominance at R=2H+2. This proves two roots outside; certify d-2 disjoint inside-root disks for the full f. Together the count covers ALL d roots without locating the huge two. No semiprime/composite or hard-factor promise is claimed for the N sample. No hidden factors or instance-selection advice.

Approximate proposals only: use simultaneous Aberth on degree-(d-2) truncation normalized by max coefficient; fixed Cauchy-circle half-phase start; <=500 sweeps, correction cutoff2^-42, rationalize centers on2^-40 grid, fixed radius2^-24. No alternative starts/precisions/method tuning after outcomes. Exact verification uses full integer f. Approximate root errors return unknown. Ensure repeated roots/domain failures/disjointness/global count are handled honestly. Use coefficient dominance plus all inside disks, not an unverified assumption that omitted roots are outside.

Efficient exact arithmetic suggestion (not a different protocol): for z=(x+iy)/Q, compute Taylor coefficients of f(z+Y) with common denominator Q^d by integer Gaussian Horner shifting. At each degree extension multiply old coefficient by x+iy, add Q times its predecessor, and add f_i Q^level to the constant coefficient. This requires O(d²) small-multiplier integer operations, avoiding Fraction normalization on huge coefficients. The independent reference must instead use the direct binomial formula with precomputed Gaussian powers. For t=2^-24, clear the shared denominator and radius powers in the strict Rouche inequality. Squarefree certificate can carry Bezout polynomials modulo65537, independently multiply them to1. Certify N base by exact m^d<=N<(m+1)^d, digits/degree/monicity and f(m)=N. Efficient integer Newton root is allowed; don't use a floating root for huge N.

Compute positive rational kappa_cert using exact pair/triple bounds and record it; clear denominators in H017 eq11, calculate exact finite primitive count. Record huge comparison products via bit lengths and SHA-256 plus their exact factored operands; serialize huge integers in hex to avoid Python decimal digit limits. No numeric all-output bound from an unspecified O constant. Preserve reducible/square-class and heuristic comparison qualifications.

Five frozen verifier controls are specified in H019.md, then four research inputs. Exactly one run:55s internal setup+controls+attempts+reference/evidence,60s external. Each research worker killable12s cap further limited by remaining wave budget; all controls<=3s. Freeze code, independent reference, full expanded protocol/input rule/constants/cases/hashes before execution; archive all generated input hex. Input generation can precede freeze but its elapsed work must enter the55s setup budget. No candidate smoke execution or hidden exploratory run before freeze. Syntax checks allowed. Original source cannot be modified or rerun after the single trial to improve outcomes; report bugs/outcomes honestly and retain a future revised round separately.

Use independent arithmetic reference rather than calling candidate Taylor/predicate helpers. Retain passes, unknowns, verification failures, errors,timeouts,unstarted in fixed denominator with stage counters/times. Runner refuses overwriting evidence and preserves statuses if workers die. The registered finite continuation criterion requires correct controls AND certificates on both largest cases; do not weaken it if only one passes. A failed sufficient geometry inequality is unknown, not positive supply. A timeout is a censored implementation result. A valid individual certificate still proves its own exact finite count even if overall criterion is inconclusive.

Deliver proof-linked implementation, reproducible frozen evidence, exact per-case count/disposition and best supported scope. No sharing/publication or automatic new experiment. Significant finite claims will need independent review. Parent will run shared project checks after handoff; you may run syntax checks only before frozen experiment. Verified factoring complexity improvement NONE.
